questions.prompt: How should we check for Vulkan hardware support?
questions.description: We need to dynamically set TRANSCRIBE_VULKAN=ON if active.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Check for vulkaninfo and look for supported devices.

questions.prompt: How should the model download menu be presented in `just model dl`?
questions.description: Omega-13 currently uses `gum` for UI in its bash scripts.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Use `gum choose` to list the models.

questions.prompt: Should we delete the old bash scripts (`install.sh`, `uninstall.sh`, `bootstrap.sh`) after migration?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Yes, replace them entirely with the Justfile.
